calculation_policy.method: For each company and explicit basis, use latest actual point T; select the latest disclosed actual points at or before T minus three calendar months and T minus six calendar months. Keep every selected point actual date and disclosure qualifier. No interpolation, invented month points, cross-company sum, or gross/net conversion. Each historical cutoff anchor must lag by at most 31 days; otherwise this company/basis is unavailable. Cutoffs, actual dates and lags are reported separately; this is not exact cutoff-date economic revenue growth.
calculation_policy.date_precision: as_of may be a conservative interval upper bound when the source does not identify a day; as_of_precision and observed_interval retain that uncertainty. Such values are not described as exact daily measurements.
calculation_policy.qualifiers: Arithmetic uses the reported rounded value/bound as an indicative estimate. More-than/nearly/about qualifiers remain visible; the result is not an independently verified exact revenue measurement.
calculation_policy.incremental_updates: After this backfill, append newly disclosed actual points by id. Do not regenerate or clear the historical ledger. Source corrections preserve an audit record and explain any basis reclassification.

anthropic_gross.qualification: Reported rounded / greater-than run rates; latest-known quarterly cutoff method, not fabricated exact quarter-end observations.

openai_net.reason: Only the corrected September point has a confirmed net basis; earlier actual observations are retained as unspecified. Two same-basis historical quarter anchors still require confirmation.

backfill_findings.coverage: Nine actual observations fall inside the requested nine-month observation window, plus two explicitly marked year-end opening anchors. Months without a disclosed actual observation are not filled with forecasts or synthetic readings.
